section_summary.extract_value: This Introduction section establishes the theoretical foundation for examining associations between femininity ideology and body appreciation. The text reviews literature on body image disorders and their correlates, introduces the Femininity Ideology Scale (FIS) with its five factors, and explains why body appreciation (rather than negative body image) was selected as the outcome variable. The study aims to examine correlations between FIS factors and body appreciation, with specific hypotheses about which factors (Stereotypic Image and Activities, Purity) are expected to negatively correlate with body appreciation.

section_summary.extract_value: This introduction section presents a single study examining the relationship between femininity ideology (measured via the Femininity Ideology Scale with five factors) and body appreciation among women. Table 1 provides descriptive statistics and inter-item correlations for 135 female participants, showing a weak negative correlation (r = -.19, p < .05) between body appreciation and body mass index, with mean age of 23.74 years and mean BMI of 22.15.
